about: Rows of the Federal Reserve Board's press-release feed (www.federalreserve.gov/json/ne-press.json, read 2026-11-01: 4,650 releases from 2006-01-10 to 2026-10-29), as the Board gives them, in its order: the 213 releases of the three types read that the party rules give a company in the committed index (225 matches on 103 companies, replayed from all 2,219 rows of those types), the near misses they must refuse — releases whose letters hold a large bank's name and that make none a party — the namesakes refused by hand (Fortis, Banco Popular Español, Citizens Banking Corporation), Truist's capital plan of 2013 as BB&T, Popular's 2010 order under its bank's name, two Monetary Policy and two Enforcement Actions rows, which are not read, one row linking off the Board's site, and the feed's closing update row.
